task.title: Fly through rings
task.goal: Take off, then fly through 4 rings in order. Each ring is a vertical circle of 60 m radius, passed by flying through it in its heading. No landing needed. The aircraft is a quadcopter drone: it takes off and lands vertically, hovers in place and flies forward at up to 45 kt.

result.reason: time budget of 750 s of simulated time reached
